question: Can any circumstance be entirely free from the experience of auspicious and inauspicious results?
premises: Auspicious and inauspicious outcomes are to be experienced.
No situation is devoid of such experience.
inference: Experience of both auspicious and inauspicious results is unavoidable in all circumstances.
plain_english: Auspicious and inauspicious things must be experienced, and nowhere is one ever devoid of them.
